scope: Current supervised workflow only; a future automatic default requires user agreement
retained_checks: actual saved PID, mode, phase and EEPROM lock
serial packet integrity and communication errors
fault_policy: Stop further command dispatch; no automatic neutral command, retarget or torque release
user_authorization: User cancelled proposed motion envelope/speed/feedback-gap/settle/release conditions and chose case-by-case confirmation per stage, retaining torque after neutral.
pick_demo_policy: User-accepted K230 four-stage automatic pick uses configs/arm/k230_pick_config.json; it does not call the manual run method.
